subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining independent-media batching be implemented as a LINE/plugin-owned opt-in buffer, a shared channel SDK/gateway coalescer, or deferred to narrow per-channel bugs?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes public config, latency, session/turn boundaries, webhook semantics, and the plugin-versus-core owner boundary, so automation should not choose the permanent product/API direction.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
options.body: Implement an opt-in same-account/conversation/sender media buffer in the affected channel plugin first, adding shared SDK helpers only if duplication appears across channels.

options.title: Design a shared coalescer
options.body: Create a broader channel SDK or gateway media coalescing contract before implementation, accepting larger API, config, and compatibility review.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Keep text debounce and Telegram album support as the supported behavior for now, and handle only narrower channel bugs such as WhatsApp steer media loss through their own trackers.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
recommendation.body: Implement an opt-in same-account/conversation/sender media buffer in the affected channel plugin first, adding shared SDK helpers only if duplication appears across channels.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans shared debounce policy, plugin/core ownership, and config compatibility, and history ties this owner to those surfaces.
